name: handup
description: Ask a human before risky actions: approvals, questions and notices from your agent to your terminal, desktop or phone.

interface.shortDescription: Ask a human before risky actions
interface.longDescription: handup is an approval inbox for AI agents. Your agent asks before migrations, releases, emails and other risky actions, asks questions when it needs a choice, and sends notices when work finishes. You approve, deny or answer from your terminal, the desktop app or your phone. Requires the handup app on this computer (https://gethandup.dev/downloads).
defaultPrompt: Ask me with handup before you run the database migration.
Use handup to ask me which region to deploy to.
